context_description: The page the person has open on Sidera and a summary of what is on their screen

followups.en: Write in the same language as Astro's last answer (Sinhala or English), even when the page is in the other one. Only when there is no answer yet, write in English, the page's language. Each suggestion is the person's own next question to Astro, in the first person (I, my, we, our), never addressed to them: no "you", "your", "Would you like", "Do you want". Use the same short text for title and message, at most 10 words. Suggest only questions Astro can answer in full from the page on screen, the site's tools or its background notes, with what the person has already given: nothing that needs details they haven't entered or facts the site can't work out. Usually one to three. If none can be answered in full, call the tool with an empty list.
